entities.label: SPRUJ26A
entities.description: Motor Control SDK Universal Project and Lab User's Guide; explains running motor drive EVMs with the Universal Motor Control Lab, migrating to a custom board, and porting to a new C2000 device.
aliases: Motor Control SDK Universal Project and Lab
Universal Motor Control Project and Lab User's Guide

properties.sections: Introduction; Motor Control Theory; Running the Universal Lab on TI Hardware Kits; Building a Custom Board; Appendix A Motor Control Parameters

entities.label: Universal Motor Control Lab
entities.description: Single project with build examples for sensorless (FAST, eSMO, InstaSPIN-BLDC) and sensored (incremental encoder, Hall) motor control techniques (FOC, trapezoidal), with system features and debug interfaces usable across three-phase inverter motor EVMs.

properties.requires: CCS v12.0.0+, C2000 Compiler v22.6.0 LTS+, C2000Ware MotorControl SDK v4.01.00+

entities.label: MotorControl SDK
entities.description: SDK containing the universal motor control solution and lab project; includes firmware that runs on C2000 motor control EVMs and TI designs, and ships a copy of C2000Ware.

entities.label: C2000Ware
entities.description: Provided as part of the MotorControl SDK; offers device-specific drivers, support software and complete example system applications.

entities.label: Code Composer Studio
entities.description: IDE required by the Universal Motor Control Lab; some user parameters can be manipulated through CCS at run time.

entities.label: C2000 Compiler
entities.description: Compiler required by the Universal Motor Control Lab.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-FOC
entities.description: FAST observer is implemented with InstaSPIN-FOC in the lab; no longer requires a C2000 device with special ROM content. Uses measured stator voltage and current to estimate rotor position and speed during flying start.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-BLDC
entities.description: Sensorless technique offered as a build example in the Universal Motor Control Lab.

entities.label: FAST estimator
entities.description: FAST library estimates motor Flux, Angle, Speed and Torque; requires FPU-enabled C2000 devices supported by C2000Ware-MotorControl-SDK. Called via EST_run in the FOC ISR.

properties.outputs: flux, angle, speed, torque, Rs, Lsd, Lsq, flux psi_s

entities.label: user_mtr1.h
entities.description: Header file that stores all user parameters; parameters must be updated here to be saved permanently in the project.

entities.label: hal.h
entities.description: HAL header modified to migrate the lab to custom hardware or port to other C2000 MCUs.

entities.label: hal.c
entities.description: HAL source file modified to migrate the lab to custom hardware or port to other C2000 MCUs.

entities.label: DATALOG
entities.description: Data logging module optionally run at the end of the main ISR.

entities.label: PWMDAC
entities.description: PWM-based DAC output module optionally run in the main ISR.

entities.label: C2000
entities.description: TI MCU platform; the lab can be ported to other C2000 MCU controllers.

entities.label: F28002x
entities.description: C2000 MCU series supported by the Universal Motor Control Lab example.

entities.label: F28003x
entities.description: C2000 MCU series supported by the Universal Motor Control Lab example.

entities.label: F280013x
entities.description: C2000 MCU series supported by the Universal Motor Control Lab example.

entities.label: FPU
entities.description: Floating-point unit; FAST observer for InstaSPIN-FOC requires FPU enabled.

entities.label: ADC
entities.description: Samples motor phase currents, phase voltages and DC bus voltage; read via HAL_readAdcData. Max ADC input is 3.3 V.

entities.label: ePWM
entities.description: PWM driver outputs (PWM1A/B..PWM3A/B) driving the three-phase inverter; written via HAL_writePwmData.

entities.label: CAN
entities.description: CAN interface can be used to start/stop the motor and set the reference speed.

entities.label: PMSM
entities.description: Permanent magnet synchronous motor: wound stator, permanent magnet rotor, and devices to sense rotor position; low rotor inertia, efficient heat dissipation, reduced size. Not self-starting.

entities.label: IPMSM
entities.description: Interior PMSM; has electromagnetic and reluctance torque due to large saliency ratio, total torque non-linear in rotor angle; MTPA used to optimize torque.

entities.label: SPM
entities.description: Surface-mounted PMSM; easier to control due to linear torque vs q-axis current relation; conventional control sets id to zero.

entities.label: DC motor
entities.description: Stator and rotor excitation are independently controlled so torque and flux can be tuned independently; commutator keeps rotor flux orthogonal to stator field.

entities.label: ACIM
entities.description: Asynchronous/induction machine: rotor speed differs from rotor flux speed (slip); needs non-zero flux reference and a current model to compute rotor flux angle.

entities.label: Three-phase inverter
entities.description: Standard three-phase (two-level voltage source) inverter driven by PWM signals to control the motor; its max phase voltage is limited by DC-link voltage and PWM strategy.

entities.label: Voltage feedback circuit (resistor divider)
entities.description: Resistor-divider circuit that filters and scales motor phase and DC bus voltages for the ADC input range.

entities.label: FOC
entities.description: Field Oriented Control (rotor flux oriented / vector control): decouples torque and magnetizing flux components of stator current via Clarke and Park transforms into a time-invariant d-q system, similar to DC machine control.

properties.torque_eq: tau_em = B_stator x B_rotor (Eq 6); tau_em ∝ psi_R x i_sq (Eq 7)

entities.label: Sensorless FOC
entities.description: FOC of a PMSM without mechanical position sensor using eSMO+PLL or FAST to estimate rotor angle and speed; shown with flying start or with FWC and MTPA.

entities.label: Trapezoidal control
entities.description: Motor control technique offered in the lab alongside FOC.

entities.label: eSMO
entities.description: Enhanced sliding mode observer; uses back-EMF model together with a PLL to estimate rotor position and speed for sensorless IPMSM control at middle/high speed; relies on software-estimated phase voltages rather than phase-voltage sensing.

entities.label: Sliding Mode Observer
entities.description: Observer based on sliding mode control; structure purposefully changed by system state to follow a sliding trajectory; fast response, robust, insensitive to parameter changes and disturbances. Traditional reduced-order SMO uses a motor-model current observer, bang-bang control, LPF and angle calculator.

entities.label: PLL
entities.description: Quadrature phase-locked loop position tracker that estimates rotor angular velocity and position from estimated back-EMF, eliminating noise/harmonic effects of the arctangent method.

properties.position_error: eps = e_beta*cos(th^) - e_alpha*sin(th^) = E*sin(th - th^) (Eq 21); eps_n = th - th^ (Eq 23)

entities.label: Clarke transform
entities.description: Projects 3-phase (a,b,c) quantities into the 2-axis orthogonal stationary (alpha,beta) frame; output is time-variant.

entities.label: Park transform
entities.description: Most important FOC transform: projects (alpha,beta) into the rotating (d,q) frame aligned with rotor flux, giving DC (time-invariant) flux and torque current components; needs rotor flux position.

properties.equation: i_sd = i_salpha cos(th) + i_sbeta sin(th); i_sq = -i_salpha sin(th) + i_sbeta cos(th) (Eq 10)

entities.label: Inverse Park transform
entities.description: Converts Vsdref, Vsqref from current regulators to Vsalpharef, Vsbetaref in the stationary frame; needs rotor flux position.

entities.label: SVPWM
entities.description: Space Vector PWM takes Vsalpharef/Vsbetaref and produces signals (Ta, Tb, Tc) that drive the inverter; limits max voltage to vdc/sqrt3.

entities.label: PI controller
entities.description: Proportional-integral regulator used for speed, Id, Iq and field-weakening loops and in the PLL.

entities.label: Speed PI controller
entities.description: Speed regulator whose output is the torque command Iq_ref (or Is_ref with FW/MTPA); disabled during flying start.

entities.label: Id/Iq current PI controllers
entities.description: Current regulators comparing isd/isq with isdref/isqref; outputs Vsdref and Vsqref fed to inverse Park.

entities.label: Speed trajectory ramp
entities.description: Traj Ramp that ramps the speed reference SpdRef to wref for the speed controller.

entities.label: MTPA
entities.description: Maximum torque per ampere: computes current angle beta_mtpa and id/iq references to maximize torque for IPM motors in the constant torque region using reluctance torque; Ld/Lq from a LUT.

properties.id_iq: Id = Is cos(beta_mtpa); Iq = Is sin(beta_mtpa) (Eq 39-40)

entities.label: Field weakening
entities.description: Weakens air-gap flux via negative id (d-axis armature reaction) to run above base speed; FW PI controller on voltage magnitude error outputs beta_fw, saturated at 0 until voltage limit reached.

entities.label: FW/MTPA switching control
entities.description: Decides which current angle to apply: beta = beta_fw if beta_fw > beta_mtpa, else beta_mtpa; then computes id/iq references from Is_ref.

entities.label: Ld/Lq look-up table
entities.description: Robust LUT method modeling Ld as a function of id and Lq as a function of iq, ensuring controllability under parameter variation.

entities.label: Low-pass filter (SMO)
entities.description: Filters discontinuous switching signals z_alpha, z_beta to estimate EEMF; introduces phase delay compensated by delta_theta.

properties.cutoff: wc = 2*pi*fc, chosen per stator current fundamental frequency

entities.label: Bang-bang control
entities.description: Sign-function switching of the current estimation error producing sliding feedback z.

entities.label: Arctangent angle calculation
entities.description: Rotor position computed directly from arctangent of estimated back-EMF; accuracy affected by noise and harmonics.

entities.label: Euler discretization
entities.description: Used to transform the SMO into a time-discrete observer for digital control.

entities.label: Current model
entities.description: Basic method to calculate rotor flux angle in asynchronous machines using two motor model equations in d-q frame.

entities.label: Voltage reconstruction
entities.description: Volt_Rec block reconstructing alpha-beta phase voltages from Vbus and PWM for eSMO.

entities.label: Current reconstruction
entities.description: Step in the main ISR reconstructing phase currents after ADC offset removal.

entities.label: HAL_writePwmData
entities.description: HAL function writing SVM outputs to the PWM driver.

entities.label: HAL_readAdcData
entities.description: HAL function reading ADC phase currents/voltages.

entities.label: EST_run
entities.description: Function call running the FAST estimator in the ISR.

entities.label: Enable_FS
entities.description: Flag enabling the flying start module.

entities.label: User_IdRef
entities.description: User d-axis current reference fed to Id_ref.

entities.label: Irated
entities.description: Rated current input in FOC block diagrams.

entities.label: USER_ADC_FULL_SCALE_VOLTAGE_V
entities.description: Software value used by eSMO to represent phase voltages; depends on the voltage feedback circuit.

entities.label: Current scale value
entities.description: Hardware-dependent parameter that must be set correctly to identify and run the motor with FOC.

entities.label: Voltage scale value
entities.description: Hardware-dependent parameter that must be set correctly to identify and run the motor with FOC.

entities.label: Voltage filter pole
entities.description: Hardware-dependent parameter for voltage feedback filtering for FAST or eSMO.

entities.label: Kmtpa
entities.description: Motor-parameter-based MTPA constant computed in the background loop with updated Ld and Lq.

entities.label: Gmtpa
entities.description: Intermediate MTPA variable computed in the ISR.

entities.label: Sliding mode gains k_alpha, k_beta
entities.description: Constant sliding mode gains designed by Lyapunov stability analysis.

entities.label: PLL kp, ki
entities.description: Proportional and integral gains of the PLL PI regulator.

entities.label: fc (LPF cutoff)
entities.description: Cutoff frequency of SMO LPF, selected according to stator current fundamental frequency.

entities.label: Back-EMF
entities.description: Voltage induced by rotor; field weakening reduces it; speed and position estimated from BEMF voltages when spinning.

entities.label: Extended EMF (EEMF)
entities.description: Extended electromotive force in alpha-beta axes, the only term containing rotor position information; e = [lambda_pm + (Ld-Lq) id] we [-sin th; cos th] (Eq 3); magnitude E = we*lambda_pm.

entities.label: Rotor flux position (theta)
entities.description: Core of FOC; needed by Park and inverse Park; error misaligns d-axis. In synchronous machines measured by position sensor or speed integration.

entities.label: Rotor electrical angular velocity (omega_e)
entities.description: Electrical angular velocity of the rotor; estimated by PLL/FAST and fed back to speed PI.

entities.label: d-axis current (id)
entities.description: Flux component of stator current; set to zero for PMSM, negative for field weakening, computed by MTPA for IPMSM.

entities.label: q-axis current (iq)
entities.description: Torque component of stator current; linear relation with torque at fixed rotor flux.

entities.label: Stator current space vector
entities.description: Complex vector i_s = ia + a*ib + a^2*ic with a = e^(j2pi/3) (Eq 8).

entities.label: d-q rotating reference frame
entities.description: Rotor reference frame aligned with rotor flux in which currents become DC quantities.

entities.label: alpha-beta stationary reference frame
entities.description: Two-axis orthogonal stationary frame with alpha aligned with phase a.

entities.label: PMSM d-q dynamic model
entities.description: [vd;vq] = [Rs+pLd, -we Lq; we Ld, Rs+pLq][id;iq] + [0; we lambda_pm] (Eq 1); alpha-beta model Eq 2; state equation Eq 4.

entities.label: Stator resistance (Rs)
entities.description: Resistance of stator windings; negligible at high speed.

entities.label: d-axis inductance (Ld)
entities.description: d-axis inductance; varies with id and saturation.

entities.label: q-axis inductance (Lq)
entities.description: q-axis inductance; varies with iq and saturation.

entities.label: Permanent magnet flux linkage (lambda_pm / psi_m)
entities.description: Flux linkage generated by the permanent magnets.

entities.label: Sliding surface
entities.description: Selected on the stator current path: S = i^ - i (Eq 5), since stator current is the only directly measurable quantity.

entities.label: PLL position error
entities.description: eps = E sin(theta - theta^) simplified to E(theta - theta^) when error < pi/2; normalized eps_n.

entities.label: Electromagnetic torque (Te)
entities.description: Te = 3/2 p [psi_m iq + (Ld-Lq) id iq] (Eq 28): mutual (magnet) torque plus reluctance torque.

entities.label: Reluctance torque
entities.description: Torque from difference between d- and q-axis inductance (saliency), proportional to id*iq*(Ld-Lq).

entities.label: Current limit circle
entities.description: sqrt(id^2+iq^2) <= Imax (Eq 29), circle of radius Imax in d-q plane.

entities.label: Voltage limit ellipse
entities.description: sqrt(vd^2+vq^2) <= Vmax (Eq 30); ellipse shrinking with speed (Eq 32).

entities.label: Constant torque region
entities.description: IPMSM region I where MTPA ensures maximum torque generation.

entities.label: Constant power region
entities.description: IPMSM region II where field weakening must be employed, torque capacity reduced.

entities.label: Constant voltage region
entities.description: IPMSM region III where deep field weakening keeps constant stator voltage.

entities.label: Stator current angle (beta)
entities.description: Angle of stator current in d-q frame: Id = Is cos(beta), Iq = Is sin(beta) (Eq 33-35).

entities.label: beta_mtpa
entities.description: Current angle generated by MTPA control.

entities.label: beta_fw
entities.description: Current angle output of the FW PI controller.

entities.label: DC bus voltage (Vbus)
entities.description: Sampled DC link voltage; limits maximum inverter output voltage.

entities.label: Motor phase current
entities.description: Measured stator current; only directly measurable physical quantity; two phases fed to Clarke.

entities.label: Motor phase voltage feedback
entities.description: Phase voltages measured directly for FAST for best performance over widest speed range; not required by eSMO.

entities.label: Pull-out
entities.description: Loss of synchronism when stator field does not rotate at rotor frequency; reason synchronous machine is not self-starting.

entities.label: Overcurrent trip
entities.description: Can occur when starting a spinning motor in normal mode; prevented by flying start.

entities.label: Mechanical position sensor
entities.description: Rotor position sensor; increases cost, size, reliability problems in home appliances.

entities.label: Incremental encoder
entities.description: Sensored rotor position feedback option.

entities.label: Hall sensor
entities.description: Sensored rotor position feedback option.

entities.label: Saliency ratio
entities.description: Large saliency ratio of IPMSM yields reluctance torque.

entities.label: Base speed
entities.description: Field weakening extends operation above base speed / rated speed.

entities.label: Flying start
entities.description: Determines speed and direction of a spinning motor and starts output at that speed; applies zero torque current, estimates position/speed, then enables speed closed loop.

entities.label: Sensorless control
entities.description: Rotor speed/position estimation without mechanical sensor (FAST, eSMO, InstaSPIN-BLDC).

entities.label: Sensored control
entities.description: Control using incremental encoder or Hall sensors.

entities.label: Motor identification
entities.description: Enable Motor Identification option of the FAST estimator (Rs, Lsd, Lsq, flux).

entities.label: Rs online recalibration
entities.description: Enable Rs Online Recalibration option with FAST; Id/Iq references updated for Rs online in ISR.

entities.label: Force angle startup
entities.description: Enable Force Angle Startup option with FAST.

entities.label: Start/stop and speed reference interface
entities.description: Interface functions to start/stop motor and set reference speed via push button, potentiometer, or CAN.

entities.label: Over-modulation
entities.description: Driver parameters set for over-modulation voltage; PWM compensation for over modulation run in ISR.

entities.label: ADC offset calculation
entities.description: ADC offsets calculated at startup with PWM at 50% duty and removed from ADC results in ISR.

entities.label: Home appliances
entities.description: PMSM widely used in home appliances; sensorless control avoids sensor cost.

entities.label: Air-conditioner fan drive
entities.description: Flying start is important for fan drive in air-condition applications.

entities.label: Compressor and fan motors
entities.description: Current/voltage scale and voltage filter pole calculation for compressor and fan motor control.
